message:
{
  "verdict": "escalate",
  "summary": "The front of the mesh matches the approved concept closely and every assertion passes, but the back has no crossing harness straps, which the brief names as an identity mark. The concept only shows the front, so it can't tell us whether a concept edit or a reroll would fix it.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "check": "missing",
      "severity": "major",
      "observation": "The harness straps don't cross on the back. The back of the harness is one solid Saddle Leather vest panel from shoulders to mid-back, with no X of straps. The brief prompt asks for 'two straps crossing the chest and back', and the silhouette section names 'harness straps crossing the back' as an identity mark for a camera that sits behind the player. The front X is present.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/04_back.png, assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/09_closeup_back.png (vs 08_closeup_front.png and 01_approved_concept.png)"
    },
    {
      "check": "malformed",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The back of the vest is asymmetric. A raised strap or flap runs down the right shoulder blade only, with nothing matching it on the left.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/09_closeup_back.png"
    },
    {
      "check": "other",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The mesh has 5 parts. Besides the body there are two 6.8 cm pieces and two pieces of about 2 cm, which look like the eyebrows and eyes on the face; nothing is floating in the views. There are 13 non-manifold edges and 2 boundary loops, which is within the holes limit.",
      "evidence": "metrics.mesh.parts, metrics.mesh.non_manifold_edges, assertion 'holes (welded boundary loops)', 08_closeup_front.png"
    },
    {
      "check": "color",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The skin renders greyer and darker in the lit views than the concept's warm skin tone, although the cluster itself was corrected to within 0.1 ab.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/08_closeup_front.png vs 01_approved_concept.png; color_vs_concept #BC9781"
    }
  ],
  "escalation_reason": "The only major finding is the missing back straps. It breaks the brief, but the approved concept is front-only, so the evidence can't show whether the concept causes it or whether it is multiview generator noise. A refine_concept can't show the back, and a reroll may not add the straps. The user should decide: accept the plain back as the design, reroll, or add a back view of the concept.",
  "questions_answered": [
    "Present as in the concept: spiky dark hair, a face with a recognizable nose and eyes, the high-collared Garrison Teal tunic flaring to knee length with a front slit, the Saddle Leather harness vest with two straps crossing the chest, the leather belt, dark bracers at the wrists, dark trousers, Saddle Leather knee boots, open empty hands, T-pose. Changed or absent: the back shows a solid leather panel with no crossing straps (the concept has no back view to compare against).",
    "No fused limbs, spikes, extra props or floating fragments. Legs, arms and fingers read cleanly. There are 2 boundary loops (under the limit) and 13 non-manifold edges. The 4 small separate parts appear to be facial features. The back of the vest has an asymmetric flap on the right shoulder (minor).",
    "Yes. 4,893 triangles against a budget of 5,500, one 256x256 albedo texture, and a height of 1.8 m against the 1.8 m target.",
    "Yes, all color assertions pass. No main concept color was lost. The three unchecked colors each cover under the 5% threshold. There is no large area in an off-brief color: the navy-teal is the concept's approved rendering of Garrison Teal."
  ],
  "images_seen": [
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/01_approved_concept.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/02_front.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/03_right.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/04_back.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/05_top.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/06_clay_front.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/07_wireframe_front.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/08_closeup_front.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/09_closeup_back.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-2/10_tripo_preview_uncorrected.png"
  ]
}
